<?php
class QuietCoalesceAssignFence {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): mixed { echo "G;"; return new stdClass; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { echo "BAD_SET;"; }
}
function quietCoalesceAssignRight(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$reader = new QuietCoalesceAssignFence;
$selector = "value";
$answer = $reader->$selector ??= quietCoalesceAssignRight();
echo $answer instanceof stdClass ? "OBJECT;" : "BAD_OBJECT;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietAssignEmptyArray {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { global $present; echo "I;"; return $present; }
    public function __get(?string $incoming): array { global $reader, $selector; echo "G;"; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return []; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { echo "SET;"; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
function quietAssignArrayRight(): int { echo "RHS;"; return 9; }
$present = true;
$reader = new QuietAssignEmptyArray;
$selector = "value";
$answer = $reader->$selector ??= quietAssignArrayRight();
echo $answer === [] ? "EMPTY_ARRAY;" : "BAD_ARRAY;";
echo $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
$present = false;
$reader = new QuietAssignEmptyArray;
$selector = "value";
$answer = $reader->$selector ??= quietAssignArrayRight();
echo $answer === 9 ? "FALLBACK;" : "BAD_FALLBACK;";
$reader = null;
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietAssignSharedPayload { public function __destruct() { echo "PAYLOAD;"; } }
class QuietAssignSharedArray {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): mixed { global $reader, $selector, $items; echo "G;"; $saved = $items; $items = null; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $saved; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { echo "BAD_SET;"; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
function quietAssignSharedRight(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$items = [7, new QuietAssignSharedPayload];
$held = $items;
$reader = new QuietAssignSharedArray;
$selector = "value";
$answer = $reader->$selector ??= quietAssignSharedRight();
$answer[0] = 99;
echo $held[0] === 7 && $answer[0] === 99 && $items === null && $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "COW;" : "BAD_COPY;";
unset($answer);
echo "AFTER_FIRST;";
unset($held);
echo "DONE;";
